# Vendored fonts

Downloaded from the Google Fonts API by `tools/vendor_fonts.py`, subsets latin, latin-ext, greek. Each family is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the full text of each licence sits beside the files it covers.

- **Merriweather** — `OFL-merriweather.txt`, from <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SorkinType/Merriweather/master/OFL.txt>
- **Open Sans** — `OFL-open-sans.txt`, from <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/opensans/main/OFL.txt>
- **Fira Code** — `OFL-fira-code.txt`, from <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tonsky/FiraCode/master/LICENSE>
